title: QUIC RFC 9000 S17P4 Spin Bit Per-Path State Verification
verification_method: Focused S17P4 requirement-home tests over protected 1-RTT receive and send paths, followed by Release build, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, SpecTrace JSON validation, full Release test suite, and whitespace diff checking.
scope: This verification covers the focused generated S17P4 spin-bit per-path state proof set and the missing randomized-disablement edge proof for zero-length connection IDs.
expected_result: The focused tests show that endpoints emit the stored path spin value in protected 1-RTT short headers, servers store the received spin bit when the received packet number advances, clients store the inverse when the received packet number advances, non-increasing packet numbers do not change the client path spin value, and zero-length connection IDs remain disabled by randomized spin-bit selection.
procedure: Run the focused S17P4 spin-bit requirement-home filter.
Run the full Release test suite without rebuilding.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: The base short-header parse and packet-protection seams remain closed under ARC-QUIC-RFC9000-0001.
The existing S17P4 unsupported/disabled spin-bit behavior remains covered by earlier requirement homes.
The runtime has 1-RTT packet protection material before spin-bit receive and send proof is exercised.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim public spin-bit administration API widening, observer RTT estimation completeness, hosted interop readiness, or closure of deferred fuzz obligations.

status_summary: Local verification on 2026-05-06 passed: focused S17P4 spin-bit requirement-home filter 7/7; Release build 0 warnings/errors; regenerated QUIC coverage triage 1,320/1,771 trace-clean; SpecTrace core validation 493 artifacts; full Release no-build suite 4,585/4,585. git diff --check is recorded in the final closure report.
